questiontext.text:
According to experienced baristas, the optimal temperature to serve coffee is between \({@aa@} ^\circ F \) and \({@bb@}^\circ F\). Suppose coffee is poured at a temperature of \({@cc@}^\circ F\), and after \({@dd@}\) minutes in a \({@ee@}^\circ F\) room it has cooled to \({@ff@}^\circ F\). When is the coffee first cool enough to serve?

The coffee can be served about [[input:ans1]] minutes after it is poured. [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

When is the coffee too cold to serve?

The coffee is too cold to be served about [[input:ans2]] minutes after it is poured.[[validation:ans2]][[feedback:prt2]]

Note: Round answers to the nearest half minute.

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

We have

\[\begin{align} T & =(T_0-T_a)e^{-kt}+T_a \\ {@ff@}&=({@cc@}-{@ee@})e^{-k({@dd@})}+{@ee@} \\ {@ff-ee@}&=({@cc-ee@})e^{@-k*dd@} \\ {@(ff-ee)/(cc-ee)@}&=e^{@-k*dd@} \\ \ln {@(ff-ee)/(cc-ee)@}&={@-k*dd@} \\ \ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}&={@-k*dd@} \\ k &=\frac{ \ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}}{{@dd@}} \\ \end{align}\]

Then the model is

\[ T= {@cc-ee@} e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} +{@ee@} \]

The coffee reaches \({@bb@}^\circ F \) when

\[\begin{align} {@bb@}&= {@cc-ee@} e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} +{@ee@} \\ {@bb-ee@}&={@cc-ee@} e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} \\ {@(bb-ee)/(cc-ee)@}&= e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} \\ \ln {@(bb-ee)/(cc-ee)@}&= \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}}t \\ \ln {@num((bb-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((bb-ee)/(cc-ee))@} &= \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}}t \\ t &=\frac {{@dd@}( \ln {@num((bb-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((bb-ee)/(cc-ee))@})}{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}}\\ t &\approx {@ta1_a@} \end{align} \]

The coffee can be served about \({@ta1@}\) minutes after it is poured. The coffee reaches \({@aa@} ^\circ F \) at

\[\begin{align} {@aa@}&= {@cc-ee@} e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} +{@ee@} \\ {@aa-ee@}&={@cc-ee@} e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} \\ {@(aa-ee)/(cc-ee)@}&= e^{( \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}})t} \\ \ln {@(aa-ee)/(cc-ee)@}&= \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}}t \\ \ln {@num((aa-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((aa-ee)/(cc-ee))@} &= \frac{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} {{@dd@}}t \\ t &=\frac {{@dd@}( \ln {@num((aa-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((aa-ee)/(cc-ee))@})}{\ln {@num((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}-\ln {@denom((ff-ee)/(cc-ee))@}} \\ t &\approx {@ta2_a@} \end{align} \]

The coffee is too cold to be served about \({@ta2@}\) minutes after it is poured.
